concernFlags.issue: Directional features baseline despite strong daily bias
concernFlags.details: On a day where 75/84 bars voted UPTREND, features like bias.confirm (48%), leg.dir (48%), and dir.relation (47%) returned 48% hit — at or below the random baseline of ~50%. Either (a) these features are designed to detect reversals/consolidations (not follow-through), (b) the MFE/MAE window is misaligned with the forward decision, or (c) there is a sign-flip bug. Regime analysis shows trend bars underperform (38-40% vs chop 40-50%), suggesting these features may be weak in directional extension.
concernFlags.action: Check feature definition against MFE/MAE window. If designed for reversal detection, relabel. If designed for direction, debug the vote-vs-outcome alignment. Test on at least 10 more biased days before adjusting weights.

concernFlags.details: Only 65% of the 84 bars produced records; 35% are gaps. This is within tolerance but worth monitoring. Check whether gaps correlate with specific times or market regimes (e.g., overnight vs RTH).
concernFlags.action: If >5 consecutive days drop below 60%, file a defect in the tapereader or feature capture layer.

concernFlags.issue: pbEntry.60 incomplete — do not trust the 84% rate
concernFlags.details: Of 64 bars eligible for 60-minute forward scoring, only 32 are fully resolved. The last ~30 minutes of the session have no forward outcome yet. The 84% rate is an artifact of selection bias (only the cleanly-resolved bars are scored).
concernFlags.action: Exclude pbEntry.60 from any rules or thresholds. Re-score after market close +60m.
